name: CRM deal card
oneLiner: a sales pipeline card on a warm lit desk: a deal drops into the first stage with its value counting up, lifts and hops down the stages one by one while the other deals make room, lands in Won with a green edge, a green WON stamp thumps on and the header total adds the deal
say: when the speaker says a deal closed or a client signed ('and they signed', 'that one turned into a 24k contract'): cut in as they name the client, the stamp lands on 'signed' or 'closed'
